City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 15, 2015 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS - None
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 3/18/15 Special Joint Closed Session Meeting and the 3/18/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S8B - Warrants
8C.
San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
Accept San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S8C - San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update
8D.
Adopt Resolution No. 2015-04, supporting the American Water Works Association's Drinking Water Week on May 3-9, 2015. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
Adopt Resolution No. 2015-04, supporting the American Water Works Association's Drinking Water Week on May 3-9, 2015.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S8D - Resolution No. 2015-04 AWWA's Drinking Water Week
8E.
Notice of Completion for the Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project CW01A. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
Authorization to file a "Notice of Completion" (NOC) for the Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project (Project) constructed by Piperin Corporation, Project CW01A.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S8E - Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project NOC
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Ordinance No. 2015-01, revising Article 29 of the District's Administrative Code - Drought Response Conservation Program. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-01 entitled "An Ordinance of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Revising Article 29 of the District's Administrative Code - Drought Response Conservation Program."
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S10A - Ordinance No. 2015-01 Administrative Code Article 29 (Drought Response Conservation Program) Revision
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational update on the 2015 National Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
Receive the update, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S11A - Informational Update on the 2015 National Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation
11B.
Informational presentation on the Drought and Response to the District's Declaration of a Drought Response Level 2 Condition. Contact Person: General
Manager O'Donnell
Receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2015-04-15 SDWD Item S11B - Informational Presentation on Drought Level 2
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S15.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
